name: Sakaehara Kyouka
source:
A third year student and vice president of the student council. She is a straightforward, too serious, inflexible person that constantly opposes Itsuki. She is an enthusiastic Christian and takes Itsuki along to church to participate in events. 

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
